newsitem.title: POLAND: OKOCIM TO LAY OFF UP TO 193 EMPLOYEES.
newsitem.headline: OKOCIM TO LAY OFF UP TO 193 EMPLOYEES.

text.p: Polish brewer Okocim SA said in a statement on Wednesday it planned to lay off up to 193 of its 1,109 employees and said the lay off was approved by the trade unions, the company said in a statement on Wednesday.
Okocim said the lay off was likely to positively influence the firm's costs and capacity and therefore have a positive impact on its financial results, but did not give any figures.
Okocim said it planned to earmark 5.2 million zlotys for severance pays, but said the provisions for them where already calculated in 1997 results forecast presented in April.
In April Okocim said it expected its net profit to fall to between 16 and 18 million zlotys from last year's 27.2 million due to large investments in marketing and distribution.
